title: ProblemDetails
description: Standard error object returned by the API for rejected requests. Spec IDs: APP.VALIDATION.001, APP.RATE.LIMIT.001, APP.LOCATION.PROVIDER.RESILIENCE.001. For rate-limit rejections (HTTP 429) the response additionally includes a `Retry-After` header stating how long the caller should wait before issuing the next request.

type.description: URI reference identifying the error type.

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the error type.

status.description: HTTP status code associated with the error.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation of this specific occurrence of the error.

errors.description: Field-specific validation messages. Absent or empty when the failure is not field-specific.
